name: List the S&P 500 Constituents Financials
author: Maksym Marko

sections.description:
The plugin display the list of S&P 500 companies. You can place the shortcode [mx_display_s_and_p_500] to your website and to allow your users looking for a company by name.
This plugin is based on the https://datahub.io/ functionality (https://pkgstore.datahub.io/core/s-and-p-500-companies-financials/3/datapackage.json). List of companies that you can see, is provided by https://datahub.io/ (free resource).

How does it work?
sections.installation:
From your WordPress dashboard

  1. Visit ‘Plugins > Add New’
  2. Search for ‘List the S&P 500 Constituents Financials’
  3. Activate the plugin from your Plugins page.

From WordPress.org

  1. Download ‘List the S&P 500 Constituents Financials’.
  2. Upload the ‘List the S&P 500 Constituents Financials’ directory to your ‘/wp-content/plugins/’ directory, using your favorite method (ftp, sftp, scp, etc…)
  3. Activate ‘List the S&P 500 Constituents Financials’ from your Plugins page.
